cases.positive_identity_finding: Official Ayurveda Aahara Compendium identifies Narikela Ksheerika: Cocos nucifera endosperm and milk (1 part), cooked together, not plain fluid milk.
questions: Exact Narikela Ksheerika recipe, Cocos nucifera endosperm and milk quantities
Process/cooking and actual sold form with all additives
Authenticity of specific Ayurveda Aahara eligibility and applicable current category
Legal CTR 'Milks' vs milk-containing composite/other article, not automatic transfer
Finished cooked recipe matrix, representative lot and signed analytical/legal review
cases.no_transfer: Even a classical recipe with a stated milk ingredient is not automatically the CTR finished article 'Milks'.

cases.positive_identity_finding: Official Ayurveda Aahara Compendium lists Ksheerapaka containing buffalo milk, scented floral water/aromatic flowers, water and sugar, with cooking/reduction process.
questions: Recipe traceable to named Ksheerapaka: buffalo milk, aromatic flowers, water and sugar

Food category and specific regulatory identity for this Ayurvedic composite
Specific current CTR 'Milks' source applicability versus finished multi-ingredient mixture
Correct final sample, production evidence, analytical basis and signed regulatory review
cases.no_transfer: Buffalo milk in the recipe alone does not prove the reduced, sweetened, aromatic final recipe is a plain 'Milks' finished product.
